security_audit.summary: Most external command and system reconnaissance alerts are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline paths, and SQL examples. Confirmed risks remain for machine-specific hidden filesystem paths, .env credential guidance, and direct access to nonprofit finance database records. No prompt injection attempt was found, but the skill exposes personal finance context and includes destructive database workflows.

remediation.suggestion: Replace absolute /home/adamsl paths with project-relative setup steps and require user confirmation before sourcing a local environment.
Do not instruct agents to read .env files directly. Document required variable names and ask users to verify secrets locally.
Add explicit read-only guidance, backups, dry-run checks, and confirmation before insert, delete, or initialization operations.

remediation.issue: Personal and organization names in finance examples
remediation.suggestion: Anonymize people, ministries, and recipient examples before publishing the skill to a public marketplace.

content.value_statement: Receipt workflows often require manual entry, OCR setup, and database checks across several scripts. This skill gives operators project-specific commands, schemas, and troubleshooting steps for receipt tools.
actual_capabilities: Identifies project paths, virtual environment setup, and receipt tool entry points.
Documents database schemas for categories, merchants, expenses, and receipt metadata.
Provides commands for manual receipt entry, deletion workflows, API service startup, and database checks.
Shows Python patterns for merchant lookup, category hierarchy queries, and expense saving.
Describes troubleshooting steps for missing modules, schema errors, and database connectivity.
Lists planned enhancements for receipt upload, OCR integration, bulk import, and search.
limitations: It depends on local project paths and database schemas that may not exist in another environment.
It provides operational guidance, not the executable source files for the referenced tools.
It requires database credentials and a Gemini API key to be configured outside the skill.
Receipt upload, bulk import, and search are listed as future tasks, not current capabilities.

use_cases.title: Record Nonprofit Receipts
use_cases.description: Use the manual entry workflow to select merchants, dates, amounts, categories, and save confirmed expenses.

use_cases.title: Maintain Receipt Tooling
use_cases.description: Use the schema notes and code patterns to fix queries or add a new receipt command-line tool.

use_cases.title: Review Expense Data
use_cases.description: Use the database check commands to inspect recent expenses, category counts, and connection status before changes.

prompt_templates.title: Open the Receipt Menu
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to show me how to activate the project environment and open the receipt tools menu. Ask before running each command.

prompt_templates.title: Enter a Manual Receipt
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through manual receipt entry for a nonprofit expense. Ask for merchant, amount, date, category, and confirmation before saving.

prompt_templates.title: Fix a Category Query
prompt_templates.prompt: A query failed with an unknown category_path column. Use the documented schema to explain the issue and propose a safer category path query.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a New Receipt Tool
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a plan for a new receipt validation command-line tool that follows the existing project patterns. Include database safety checks and test steps before any write operation.

output_examples.input: I need to add a grocery receipt for last week.
output_examples.output: The assistant asks for merchant, amount, date, expense category, and final approval. It then directs the user to the manual entry tool only after confirmation.

output_examples.input: The receipt tool says category_path does not exist.
output_examples.output: The assistant explains that the categories table stores names and parent identifiers. It recommends building the path from the hierarchy instead of using a missing column.

output_examples.input: I want to remove duplicate expenses from one date.
output_examples.output: The assistant recommends reviewing recent expenses, backing up data, and confirming exact deletion criteria before using the deletion workflow.

best_practices: Confirm before running any command that writes, deletes, or initializes database records.
Replace local absolute paths and sample names with values from the active project.
Keep credentials in local secret storage and avoid sharing environment file contents.
anti_patterns: Do not run database deletion or initialization commands without a backup and explicit approval.
Do not paste API keys, database passwords, or environment file contents into chat.
Do not treat schema examples as proof that production columns exist.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps users operate and troubleshoot receipt scanning, manual receipt entry, and database-backed expense workflows.

faq.question: Does it scan receipts automatically?
faq.answer: It documents OCR configuration and planned upload work. The current guidance focuses on manual entry and database integration.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it include the receipt tool source code?
faq.answer: No. It references project scripts and gives patterns for using or extending them.

faq.question: What local access does it need?
faq.answer: It may need access to the project directory, Python environment, database connection settings, and OCR API configuration.

faq.question: How should I use it safely?
faq.answer: Review commands before execution, avoid sharing secrets, and back up financial data before write or delete operations.
